title: Paid cloud models through the user's own DeepInfra key - UMBRELLA
description: Umbrella over six members. Fabio 2026-09-20 chose Option A from docs/proprietary-models-research after a costed review: bring your own key, no credit system, no markup, no proxy, no lawyer. The app already holds the user's DeepInfra key for the prompt enhancer, so there is no new secret and no new onboarding; the user pays DeepInfra directly and holds that contract. Local ComfyUI models stay free and untouched. Fifteen models agreed, nine of which price themselves from structured API fields while six need the measured constants MPI-850 owns. The research is measured, not estimated - 01d-deepinfra-image-video.md carries real calls costing 0.68 USD: prices to the cent, the exact Seedance token formula from an ffprobe, which tier censors this content, and the 1MP ceiling. The idea holding all six members together: the install machinery does not need teaching to PASS for a weightless model, it already passes twice by accident, it needs teaching to ask a different question - is a key saved. Decisions settled 2026-09-20: batch confirms at size 4; a userData spend ledger plus the sidecar cost; ONE DeepInfra key, the one the prompt enhancer and agent already use, with no second field; and the no-engine gate left alone, carved out to MPI-856 because blockedByNoEngine also guards creating and opening a project, so lifting it is the whole app rather than one library. The last question, pricing an edit op whose output size is unknown, turned out to affect only two of the fifteen models - FLUX 2 Dev and Seedream 5.0 Pro - because Nano Banana bills a fixed token count per resolution tier and the rest are flat or tiered.
